court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, Akola in E. Petition No.83/2009
case_name: Anil S/O Radheshyam Agrawal (Garg) vs Sau. Maya W/O Anil Agrawal (Garg)

parties.respondent_defendant: Sau. Maya w/o Anil Agrawal (Garg), wife

facts_of_case: Marriage between applicant and non-applicant was performed on 22/1/2003. Wife claimed husband and family members were making demand of Rs.2 lacs and since demand was not fulfilled, she was being mentally and physically harassed by them.

legal_principles.principle: A divorcee is entitled to maintenance under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
legal_principles.held: Considering the evidence of parties and submissions made, trial Court came to the conclusion that a divorcee is entitled to maintenance under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure

legal_principles.principle: A husband is bound in law to pay maintenance to his wife if she is unable to maintain herself.
legal_principles.held: On facts, it was observed that wife was not able to maintain herself and husband was bound in law to pay maintenance

outcome.final_order: Husband is directed to pay Rs.3000/- per month to wife towards maintenance from the date of order, i.e. 28/5/2010.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for judicial separation
preparing a response to a husband's challenge
